title: Cylindrical body
spec: Start by creating a new coordinate system with the Euler angles set to zero degrees for all axes and the translation vector also set to zero. Next, initiate a two-dimensional sketch on the X-Y plane. Within this sketch, draw a single loop consisting of one circle. Position the center of this circle at coordinates [0.015, 0.015] and set the radius to 0.015 units. After completing the sketch, apply a scaling factor of 0.03 to the entire sketch to adjust its size accordingly. Ensure that the scaled sketch remains aligned with the original coordinate system by rotating it using the Euler angles [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and translating it using the vector [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]. Proceed to extrude the scaled sketch to a depth of 0.75 units along the normal direction to create a solid cylindrical body. Avoid extruding in the opposite direction to maintain the desired shape. The final dimensions of the cylindrical body will be 0.03 units in length, 0.03 units in width, and 0.75 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").center(0.015, 0.015).circle(0.015)

# Extrude the sketch to create the pen body
pen_body = sketch.extrude(0.75, taper=0.03)

# The final model
r = pen_body

# Display the model

lanes.label: Cadabra 4B (ours) · 1 sample
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.015, 0.015)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.015)         # Draw a circle with radius 0.015
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = (
    sketch
    .extrude(0.75)         # Extrude the circle to create a cylinder of height 0.75
)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder
